C001.reason: The generated protobuf binding will have speed_kph field instead of speed_mps. The producer must set speed_kph using the converted value (request['speed'] * 3.6) before float32 serialization, as the input request.speed remains in meters per second.

C002.reason: The decoded entity will expose speed_kph instead of speed_mps. The observation key must become speed_kph to match the new schema field name, and we expose the exact decoded float32 value as a JSON number.

C003.reason: The speeding threshold must be converted from 30.0 m/s to 108.0 kph (30.0 * 3.6) and use strict greater-than comparison (> 108.0) on the decoded speed_kph value, preserving the vehicle_id and speeding decisions on adopted cases.

rationale: All three required candidates must be edited to align with the protobuf schema change from speed_mps to speed_kph. The producer scales input speed (m/s) by 3.6 before float32 serialization. The consumer reads decoded speed_kph directly for observations and threshold comparison. The threshold 30.0 m/s becomes 108.0 kph with strict > comparison. Wire field 2 remains float32; exact decoded float32 values are exposed as JSON numbers.
assumptions: Generated Python protobuf binding exposes speed_kph field after schema regeneration
Coordinated rollout ensures producer and consumer use same schema version
Input request['speed'] remains in meters per second as stated
No changes needed to vehicle_id field (field 1 unchanged)
